headline: Violent Resurgence in Weathered Expanse as Dead Lands Grind Accelerates
war_summary: Combat has flared anew across Weathered Expanse, where five fresh strategic base events unfolded over the past two hours amid intense fighting over Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, leaving one base unbuilt in no-man's-land and casualties topping nine hundred in the sector. Concurrently, Dead Lands has witnessed accelerating attrition, devouring over sixteen hundred combined casualties in two hours as Warden forces incurred the heavier share of losses following the contest at Callahan's Gate. Stlican Shelf similarly registered renewed volatility, logging two base events within two hours centered on Thornhold as casualty rates surged in the latest hour. In Stonecradle, the ferocious territorial turnover recorded earlier has paused with zero base actions across the past two hours, though steady clashes continue to bleed both sides. Nevish Line remains an active meatgrinder logging over eleven hundred combined casualties in two hours despite cooling rate trends, while Linn of Mercy exhibits accelerating casualty clips despite no fresh base captures. Mooring County has quieted down entirely in the last two hours following earlier clashes at The Wind Hills and Wiccwalk.
